info.title: Ablaki World API — implemented foundation
info.description: World API with node-scoped storage, crafting, economy, housing and cultivation. Commands require a server quote and exact replay of request_key, payload, quote_id and expected_revisions. The test environment has applied schema 34; the latest campsite changes still require runtime acceptance.

post.description: Use cells for new clients. Deprecated x/y remains compatible with old clients. Explore requires exactly one closed unoccupied cell and the explorer level min(3,max(1,abs(x),abs(y))) or use_elixir=true (one accessible unreserved backpack elixir). Only an owned campsite or its owned building/room is eligible. City and higher levels are closed. Buy accepts 1–100 distinct discovered cells; sorts y,x and atomically buys all. Prices are 1 Cr × (already paid cells + ordinal), with 5% discount from 3 cells. No partial charge on rejection; quotes and request keys remain required internally.

preview.description: POST path for a command preview when this action has one.

execute.description: POST path for the idempotent command when this action has one.

payload.description: Fixed command fields; append request_key and any other required fields from the command contract.

details.description: Type-specific fields. Private details appear only for the owner or world manager.

has_finances.description: False for rooms, beds, warehouses and shelters. Expenses use the financial parent.

home_node_id.description: Owned active house with assigned lodging, otherwise first owned house, otherwise starter campsite; null before joining. May be omitted when the world is unavailable.

Revisions.description: Keys: node:<id>, storage:<id>, inventory:<id>, instance:<id>, account:<id>, catalog, registry.

MapCellInput.description: Use cells for new clients. Deprecated x/y remains compatible with old clients. Explore requires exactly one closed unoccupied cell and the explorer level min(3,max(1,abs(x),abs(y))) or use_elixir=true (one accessible unreserved backpack elixir). Only an owned campsite or its owned building/room is eligible. City and higher levels are closed. Buy accepts 1–100 distinct discovered cells; sorts y,x and atomically buys all. Prices are 1 Cr × (already paid cells + ordinal), with 5% discount from 3 cells. No partial charge on rejection; quotes and request keys remain required internally.

amount.description: Cr decimal string; max 900000000000000.0000; never a JSON number.

wallet_after.description: Cr decimal string; max 900000000000000.0000; never a JSON number.

MapBounds.description: Fixed map bounds, editable in admin. Centred defaults: room 2x3, building 3x3, campsite 5x5, garden 5x2, settlement 12x12, region 20x20, world 32x32. The first region/city starts at (0,0); X grows right and Y grows up. A forward data migration translates existing children, absolute polygons and map rights together, preserving cell IDs, prices and operations. Existing extents can enlarge a map to avoid losing occupied cells.

Screen.description: One coherent read of the selected node, breadcrumbs, siblings and its complete map. navigation and map are both null when the world is unavailable or empty. No cross-request cache.
